title: Cone Figure-Eight Chair Control
description: Players weave the chair through a tight figure-eight of cones with no ball, isolating pivot turns and tight-turn control before adding the complexity of dribbling.

content.objective: Turn the chair tightly around each cone without losing speed or clipping it.
content.setup: Two cones are placed roughly four metres apart at the elbows; the player starts beside one.
instructions: Push toward the far cone and turn tightly around the outside of it.
Push back toward the first cone and turn tightly around it the other way.
Repeat the figure-eight continuously for 30 seconds.
Rest and repeat for three sets, trying to beat the previous lap count each time.
coachingPoints: Lead the turn with the inside hand pushing and the outside hand braking lightly.
Keep the turn tight to the cone rather than drifting wide.
Stay relaxed through the trunk — a stiff upper body makes tight turns harder.
commonMistakes: Slowing to a near-stop before every turn instead of carrying speed through it.
Drifting wide around the cone, turning a tight figure-eight into a wide loop.
Letting the trunk do the work instead of the arms and shoulders.
content.safety: Make sure the cone area is clear of other players before starting.
progressions: Add a ball held in the lap once the turn itself is clean and confident.
variations: Reverse the direction of the figure-eight halfway through the set.
